label: practice3-cart-failure
alert: High p95 latency on frontend: 8828.1 ms (baseline 344.3 ms); High p95 latency on frontend-proxy: 4600.0 ms (baseline 334.7 ms); High p95 latency on product-catalog: 9268.3 ms (baseline 326.0 ms); Traffic drop on quote: 0.033 req/s vs baseline 0.234; High p95 latency on recommendation: 8600.0 ms (baseline 920.0 ms); High p95 latency on shipping: 4550.0 ms (baseline 1550.0 ms)
summary: The application is experiencing high latency due to resource starvation in the product-catalog and opensearch containers. Both are operating near their memory limits, and product-catalog is experiencing extreme CPU saturation.

root_cause.description: The product-catalog service is experiencing severe CPU and memory starvation, causing high latency across the application. The opensearch service is also critically low on memory, further impacting system performance.

evidence.explanation: The product-catalog container is experiencing severe CPU saturation (up to 491.1%) and memory pressure (up to 99.3% usage), which correlates with the high latency observed in the service.
The opensearch container is also under extreme memory pressure (up to 99.6% usage), which likely contributes to the overall system instability and latency.
Traces show that requests to the recommendation service are blocked waiting for the product-catalog service, which in turn is slow due to its resource constraints.

ruled_out: Database failure: The astronomy-db is healthy and responding within reasonable timeframes.
Network latency: The latency is clearly tied to service processing time, not network transit.

proposed_action.reason: The services are resource-starved. Scaling them up will provide the necessary headroom to process requests efficiently.

prevention: Increase resource limits (CPU and memory) for the product-catalog and opensearch containers to handle the current load.
